description: This file defines the ContentTypeHandler class, which manages different content types and their extensions, and determines the appropriate content type for a given node based on its file extension.

classes.name: ContentTypeHandler
classes.description: Handles multiple content types, retrieves their extensions, and determines the content type for a node based on file extension.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with an array of content types and reverses the order.

methods.name: getContentExtensions
methods.description: Returns a list of all unique content file extensions supported by the registered types.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the appropriate ContentType for a given node based on its file extension, or throws an exception if none matches.
